episodes.title: Usul & Muad'Dib
episodes.break_rationale: Paul masters the Sandworm ride across the grand dunes, earning his place among the Fedaykin warriors.
episodes.recap_text: Paul Atreides and Lady Jessica earn acceptance with the Fremen of Sietch Tabr. Jessica drinks the Water of Life to become Reverend Mother while Paul bonds with Chani.
episodes.teaser_next: Guerrilla raids paralyze Harkonnen spice harvesting across Arrakis, drawing the fury of Baron Harkonnen.

episodes.title: The Northern Storm
episodes.break_rationale: Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen is introduced in the brutal gladiatorial arena of Giedi Prime and given command of Arrakis.
episodes.recap_text: Paul leads devastating raids on Harkonnen harvesters. On Giedi Prime, Feyd-Rautha celebrates his birthday in a deadly gladiatorial trial before being deployed to purge the Fremen.
episodes.teaser_next: Feyd-Rautha devastates Sietch Tabr with air bombardments, forcing Paul south to confront his messianic destiny.

episodes.title: The Water of Life
episodes.break_rationale: Paul drinks the lethal poison Water of Life, sees all futures across space and time, and awakens as the Kwisatz Haderach.
episodes.recap_text: Fleeing south, millions of fundamentalist Fremen proclaim Paul the Mahdi. Paul drinks the bile of a young sandworm and falls into a comatose trance between life and death.
episodes.teaser_next: The Emperor's armada arrives in orbit above Arrakis just as a continent-sized sandstorm bears down on the capital.

episodes.title: The Prophet's Jihad
episodes.break_rationale: Atomic breach of the shield wall, showdown with Feyd-Rautha, and the launch of the galactic holy war.
episodes.recap_text: Atomic warheads detonate the Shield Wall. Paul defeats Feyd-Rautha in single combat, claims the Imperial throne, and commands the Fremen armada to attack the Great Houses.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the epic desert sci-fi miniseries.
